description: A faint rectangular enclosure measuring approximately 600 m (N–S) by 400 m (E–W), with low-relief embankments and orthogonal internal alignments spaced at roughly 100 m intervals. Visible in the multi-angle DTM hillshade as linear ridges, coincident with subtle NIR moisture anomalies in the deforested margins, and partially obscured by modern clearings in the north.

A straight, shallow ditch or canal ca. 500 m long oriented NNE–SSW, cutting beneath forest canopy, apparent as a linear concave feature in the DTM curvature and as a narrow moisture‐retaining strip (darker tone) in the NIR band. No matching modern infrastructure appears in the OSM layer.
